longForm.heroHook: Two built-in programs. One purpose: know exactly where the culture stands.
longForm.heroLead: Guessing whether a culture has hit the right growth stage costs time and, sometimes, a whole batch. NanoPhotometer OD600 removes the guesswork with two dedicated built-in programs, OD600 and McFarland, purpose-built for fast, reproducible cell density measurement. The OD600 program tracks bacterial growth in liquid culture at 600 nm, pinpointing the exact stage for optimal harvesting. The McFarland program estimates cell suspension density against standard turbidity solutions, simplifying antimicrobial susceptibility testing and inoculum prep. A built-in Sample list function handles data management and export without extra steps.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.description: NanoPhotometer OD600 product information: built-in growth monitoring programs and sample data management.
body: The OD600 program measures optical density at 600 nm directly, monitoring bacterial growth in liquid culture media to determine growth stage and confirm optimal harvesting timing.

The McFarland program estimates cell suspension density by comparing a sample against a series of standard turbidity solutions, built specifically to simplify antimicrobial susceptibility testing and bacterial inoculum preparation.
Both programs come built into the instrument as dedicated applications, not general-purpose absorbance tools repurposed for the job.
A built-in Sample list function handles data management and export directly, reducing manual steps between measurement and usable results.
The instrument is positioned as an indispensable tool for microbial growth analysis across research, clinical, and industrial lab settings.
An OD600 DiluCell™ and an IQ/OQ Package are referenced as part of the broader Implen OD600 ecosystem for further sample handling and regulatory validation needs.

sections.title: Growth Monitoring Without the Guesswork
sections.description: Culture growth stage isn't something to eyeball. Missing the right window means either harvesting too early or letting a culture overgrow past its useful stage. The OD600 program measures optical density at 600 nm directly, the standard reference point for tracking bacterial growth in liquid culture media. That measurement translates directly into growth-stage information, letting a lab confirm optimal harvesting conditions rather than estimating them from experience or a clock.

sections.title: Standardized Turbidity, Simplified
sections.description: Comparing a cell suspension against a McFarland standard by eye introduces variability that a dedicated instrument removes entirely.
body: The McFarland program runs that comparison directly against a series of standard turbidity solutions, giving a consistent, reproducible density estimate every time.
That consistency matters most in antimicrobial susceptibility testing and inoculum preparation, where an inaccurate starting density skews the entire downstream result.
